text:
Priya (AE): Quick handoff for Suncrest — contract signed yesterday. Moving to CS for onboarding and first 90-day success plan. Key facts below, tagging @Ethan and @Rosa for owners.

Ethan (CSM): Thanks Priya. Can you post the high-priority risks and the desired go-live date? Also need admin user list.

Priya (AE): Go-live target: 2026-04-15 (pilot with 3 product teams). Primary contacts: Taylor (IT lead) taylor@suncrest.com, Morgan (PM) morgan@suncrest.com. Expected initial seat count: 12. SSO: Okta tenant suncrest.okta.com. Data residency: US-EAST only. Billing contact on file.

Priya (AE): Renewal risk: upsell within 12 months depends on pilot success. Low usage in first 2 weeks is the main risk; sales want a CS-led engagement cadence. Please prioritize onboarding enablement and weekly usage check-ins.

Ethan (CSM): Noted. I'll schedule kickoff for next Wed 10am PT. Owners: @Ethan = primary CSM, @Rosa = support escalation, Priya keeps SEA for initial exec intro.

Rosa (Support): I'll set up support access and enable case routing. Any pre-known issues? Also who is primary on-call for infra bugs?

Priya (AE): Two things to flag:
- There was a model-compat warning during demo: large attachments get truncated, workaround is to POST with `max_tokens`=1500 and enable chunked uploads.
- They need private VPC option evaluated — legal asked for an architecture diagram.

Ken (Eng): FYI we have an open ticket ENG-2789 for the attachment truncation; backlog item but workaround stands. If you need a hotfix, we can prioritize only if pilot shows blocking behavior. Workaround snippet:

```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "redwood-2.1", "max_tokens": 1500, "input": "<chunked payload>" }
```

Ethan (CSM): Good to know. I'll include the workaround in the onboarding docs. Priya, can you drop the SFDC opp link and contract start/end? Also need training material preference (live vs recorded).

Priya (AE): SFDC: https://salesforce.com/00D1a0000XXXXXX (contract 2026-03-20 -> 2027-03-19). Training: they prefer 2 live sessions + recording for team. Also asked for single-sign-on walkthrough and sample mapping for SCIM groups.

Rosa (Support): I'll prepare an internal runbook for escalation with contact list. For now add Ken as escalation owner for ENG-2789. Also will request API logs access for the CSM team.

Ops-bot: Scheduled: prod-deploy v2026.03.18 will roll 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. No expected downtime. Affected service: attachment-parser. Ticket #ENG-2789 will be monitored.

Ethan (CSM): Next steps I have:
- Send kickoff invite + agenda (by EOD)
- Create onboarding checklist and assign tasks (by Thu)
- Capture baseline usage metrics and set weekly check-in for 6 weeks
- Share training calendar and SCIM mapping sample

Priya (AE): Thanks everyone. Extra context: initial ARR $120k, commission closed. They are sensitive to demo issues; please keep exec updates simple.

Ken (Eng): If we see >2 truncation incidents in pilot week 1, ping me directly and I'll request hotfix window.

Ethan (CSM): Acknowledged. I'll post progress updates here after kickoff. :rocket:

Rosa (Support): Acknowledged — will subscribe to ticket updates and prepare the incident contact card.

Priya (AE): Closing the loop — handing off ownership to Ethan effective now. If anything urgent ping me directly. :handshake:

Ethan (CSM): Received. Team, moving to CS repo for task tracking. Conversation thread closed after initial kickoff notes posted.
